$comment: Source manifest for the BB plugin component registry (plugin design §5.5). `uiItems` lists the shadcn-shaped components under packages/shared-ui/src/components/ui that are published as registry:ui items; every file in their transitive import closure becomes its own item automatically (scripts/build-registry.mjs), so this list is the only thing to edit when adding a component. Non-registry shared-ui components (e.g. pill) are excluded until deliberately listed. `pluginFlavors` replaces a shared-ui file with a plugin-side version: the app's icon module carries the full glyph map, while a plugin's icon draws from the host's icon registry through the SDK.
